summary: A small bilingual (French roman / English italic) one-pager on black for Phantom Foundry's open-source grotesque, commissioned by Cercle magazine's ghost issue. Each chapter gets its own text colour (orange myth, violet sources, pink specimen, teal glyphs, yellow download), and the story ties the name to the Breton Ankou's cart and to vernacular 19th-century sans specimens.
